name: Warrior
description: Han General Armor: Han General, the title of the palace guard in the Ming Dynasty. There were once 1,500 Han generals in the Jinyi Guards, and the tall ones were selected as palace guards for the sake of magnificence. There are also red helmet generals, Mingjia generals, etc., who are also called palace guards. During court meetings and when the emperor goes on tour, the attendants will go out and the guards will be on duty in turns. The Han general's armor is beautiful in appearance, close to the body, easy to repair, and has strong comprehensive protection capabilities. It is a model of Chinese armor.
